verdicts_or_reports.expected: The comer card displays verb in Tags, matching its note and tag filter.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Tags header is present but comer has no tag text. Notes mode displays verb, and tag:verb finds this card. Reproduced after filtering and rotating.
steps: Options > Notes; observe comer shows verb.
Switch to Cards with Tags column enabled.
Filter by tag verb; rotate; Tags remains blank.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: Cards and Notes retain their own display settings when switching modes.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Enabled truncation and saved in Cards. Switching to Notes inherited checked truncation; disabling and saving in Notes then switching to Cards shows unchecked truncation, losing the Cards setting. Column change made while Notes was selected also appeared in Cards.
steps: In Cards open Options, enable Truncate content, Save.
Reopen Options, choose Notes; Truncate content remains checked.
Uncheck Truncate content and Save Notes.
Reopen Options and choose Cards; Truncate content is unchecked instead of its saved checked value.
Repeat toggling modes; settings track the last mode instead of retaining independent settings.
